data.action: 躺椅上拉低墨镜打量你，湿发铺开星瞳狡黠
data.camera: medium shot, lounging with sunglasses, pool glow, teasing mood
data.description: 【学园都市室内泳池·夏日】白金比基尼的女王蜂斜倚在池畔躺椅上，金色长发湿漉漉地铺开，雪白手套难得换成了裸手。她把王冠造型的墨镜往下一拉，星瞳越过镜框上缘打量你——「盯着我看的话，要收观光费哦♪ 现金……或者陪本小姐游十圈也可以。」
data.promptProse: Shokuhou Misaki lounges poolside on a deck chair in her white-and-gold bikini, wet blonde hair spread across the towel and her spider-web gloves traded for bare hands. She pulls her crown-shaped sunglasses down to peer over the frames, star-shaped pupils sizing you up as she names her sightseeing fee — cash, or ten laps by your side. Refracted pool light shimmers across her regal, teasing figure. Medium shot, cinematic lighting, detailed swimming pool background.
data.title: 食蜂操祈 · 泳池畔的王冠保养·「盯着我看的话，要收观光费哦」
